newsitem.title: UK: UK oil output in June lowest for 2 yrs- Wood Mac.
newsitem.headline: UK oil output in June lowest for 2 yrs- Wood Mac.

text.p: British oil production fell to 2.19 million barrels per day (bpd) in June from 2.30 million bpd in May, hitting its lowest level in two years, consultants Wood Mackenzie said on Monday.
June production was also 282,000 bpd down on the corresponding month last year.
Wood Mackenzie said the sharp fall represented "the full impact of biennial maintenance and operational downtime".
An extension of maintenance on the Forties pipeline system into June and water injection problems at the Scott field restricted output at Britain's biggest export stream.
Production at the Nelson field also declined when corrosion problems in a gas compressor delayed the return to full production after a scheduled shutdown.
Several fields saw production increases, including Chevron's Alba and Phillips' J-Block, WoodMac said.
However, output from Texaco's Captain field continued at a lower rate than expected due to excess gas production, the consultants said.
